name: aphrodite-hermes-runtime-layout
description: Canonical ~/.hermes layout for the Aphrodite Hermes plugin. The plugin self-heals toward this schema at startup (layout_check.py); this file is the single machine-readable reference for what is expected where. Path keys use ~/.hermes/... notation where ~ is the user home.

APHRODITE_CONFIG_PATH.purpose: User-specified location of the aphrodite runtime config. When set, config presence is checked at this path and misplaced config is moved here instead of the runtime home.

APHRODITE_BINARY_PATH.purpose: User-specified location of the aphrodite runtime binary. When set, binary checks target this path and misplaced binaries are moved here.

APHRODITE_HERMES_DYLIB_PATH.purpose: User-specified location of the libaphrodite_hermes shared library. When set, library checks target this path.

~/.hermes/aphrodite.note: Runtime home: holds ONLY aphrodite.toml (config), binaries/, directives/, ccr.db, logs. NEVER plugin source files. Stale plugin-source copies found here are quarantined to ~/.hermes/aphrodite/.stale-backup/ when their content verifies as an old or current plugin version; ambiguous files are warn-and-skip.

~/.hermes/aphrodite/aphrodite.toml.note: Runtime config. Optional (downloader or user creates it), but must never live in the plugin dir.

~/.hermes/aphrodite/binaries.note: Runtime binaries directory. Optional; the loader/downloader populates it.

~/.hermes/aphrodite/binaries/aphrodite.note: Runtime binary. Must be a real file in the runtime home, never a symlink resolving into the plugin dir.

~/.hermes/aphrodite/ccr.db.note: CCR database. Lives in the runtime home, never in the plugin dir.

~/.hermes/plugins/aphrodite.canonical_target: <plugin real path>: repo plugins/aphrodite or standalone install
~/.hermes/plugins/aphrodite.note: Pure loader/downloader. Must be a symlink to the plugin; never a real directory holding binaries, config, or ccr.db.

heal_rules.move_forbidden_to_runtime_home: copy + verify byte-identical + remove source; never overwrite an existing destination; identical duplicate at destination removes only the stale source; differing destination is warn-and-skip
heal_rules.create_missing_symlinks: plugin symlink is recreated pointing at the plugin's real path (Path.resolve()); never clobber non-empty real directories
heal_rules.never_touch_repo_checkout: if the plugin resolves into a git checkout, misplaced files are reported but not moved (developers manage the checkout)
heal_rules.quarantine_stale_plugin_source: stray plugin-source files in the runtime home are moved to ~/.hermes/aphrodite/.stale-backup/ when their content verifies as an old or current plugin version (never hard-deleted); warn-and-skip when the file cannot be compared to the tracked plugin file
heal_rules.newer_binary_in_plugin: a binary in the plugin dir that is newer than its canonical runtime-home counterpart is warn-and-skip (never moved or deleted)
